scope: Study-only SensitivityField, two compiled response modes, ordinary cubic control and targeted tests; runner, results, interpretation and mathematical proof acceptance excluded.

findings.summary: Ordinary cubic control silently accepts a Hermite sensitivity kernel.
findings.evidence: Constructing SensitivityField(config,center,hermite_binary,"chebyshev3") succeeds. Both have n=4, so C dimension check also succeeds. Wrongly initialized slope slots and ordinary collocation projection produce maximum absolute whitened row difference 492.4238541655407 versus the intended ordinary binary over test rows(511).
findings.required_change: Reject known sensitivity-mode binaries for chebyshev3 before advancing observations, and test the full binary/representation pairing matrix (including ordinary binary with sensitivity kinds). Keep original ordinary kernel unchanged if desired; its absence of sensitivity marker can identify this legacy implementation under source-bound builds.

checks.name: recurrence_and_projection_inspection
checks.detail: Taylor second derivatives use pre-interval F/F1/u/u1; Hermite slots are [values at -a,+a, slopes at -a,+a]; log-tau derivatives have positive dose*exp(-dose) first decay derivative. Coefficient matrices map samples to Chebyshev coefficients in row-major C access; unit fixed log halfwidth is inherited.

checks.name: unchanged_measurement_ownership_and_H
checks.detail: H recurrence, H projection, charge extrema, measured row and sigma scaling match legacy C. BasisField/MixedField enforce source and chronological offsets; one original-measurement row per observation and one joint QR retain all cross terms. No new truth input, prior, pseudomeasurement, or fitted centre is introduced.

checks.name: QR_fault_injection
checks.detail: For each of three modes, injected QR exception and nonfinite QR output leave state, root, count and noise unchanged.

checks.name: all_box_faces
checks.detail: For each mode, log coordinates +1.0001 and -1.0001 in each of five dimensions are rejected.

checks.name: resource_accounting
checks.detail: Taylor width34 gives packed4760B + state312B + allowance96B=5168B. Hermite/cubic width40 gives packed6560B + state360B + allowance96B=7016B. Packed estimates explicitly exclude tables, prior, scratch, calibration/platform allocations; actual implementation retains dense Python roots. No complete M23 resource or CPU improvement established.

limitations: Finite fixture checks do not validate trajectory-uniform approximation or physical coverage.
P1 proof acceptance belongs to separate independent reviewer.
No fitted-query runner, results or production promotion reviewed.
